data.text: All right. Please tell me the short version again.

prior_context.speaker: family_neha_patel
prior_context.text: I am her sister Neha. I can help with rides and check-in if needed.

prior_context.speaker: reception_jade
prior_context.text: Asha, what may Neha receive from us?

prior_context.speaker: patient_asha_patel
prior_context.text: Ride times and check-in instructions only. No diagnosis details, no test results, no medication changes, and no callback numbers.

prior_context.speaker: reception_jade
prior_context.text: I entered Neha as rides-and-check-in only, with no diagnosis details, no test results, no medication changes, and no callback numbers.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_lucy
prior_context.text: I am bringing Asha back for vitals and the neurology intake questions.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_lucy
prior_context.text: What medicines, supplements, or substances are you taking right now?

prior_context.speaker: patient_asha_patel
prior_context.text: Only sertraline 50 mg nightly and a multivitamin. I am not on seizure medicine.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_lucy
prior_context.text: I documented sertraline 50 mg nightly and a multivitamin only.

prior_context.speaker: clinician_dr_mehta
prior_context.text: I reviewed the ED note describing a probable first unprovoked seizure.

prior_context.speaker: clinician_dr_mehta
prior_context.text: Plan now: brain MRI with and without contrast, routine EEG, start levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily, and no driving for 6 months.
